policy: Only reviewed text producers with exact widget FontObjects are checked. Source changes invalidate the whole mapping, including aliases, callbacks and font overrides. Review source and callers before updating sha256. Unlisted dynamic text, template-owned fonts and consumer helper arguments have no coverage claim. Empty bindings record reviewed exclusions, not glyph coverage.

producers.review: Read all of Tracker.lua, Tracker.xml and ForeverCore TrackerSection.Create, UpdateText and TrackerLine.SetInteractive. Confirmed pinned client Blizzard_ObjectiveTrackerModule.xml: ObjectiveTrackerModuleTemplate Header inherits ObjectiveTrackerModuleHeaderTemplate, whose Text uses ObjectiveTrackerHeaderFont. Blizzard_ObjectiveTrackerBlock.xml HeaderText uses ObjectiveTrackerLineFont; Blizzard_ObjectiveTrackerShared.xml ObjectiveTrackerLineTemplate Text uses ObjectiveTrackerLineFont, inherited without overrides by ShortestPathForeverTrackerLineTemplate. Bound every local phrase sent to section headers, block headers and rows, including Journey  %s · %s from #838. RefreshBlockText preserves these widgets. Client tracker text-size changes and optional Kaliels font overrides are outside the pinned native-font coverage. Menus, chat, tooltips and dynamic text from JourneyInfo, DockTitle, and DepartureText are excluded. Reviewed #1005: the transport row menus use ForeverCore.ContextMenu. Its tooltips and labels establish no tracker FontObject. Re-reviewed for #1240: the only edit is a TrackerMenu RestedXP presence guard; no producer text, SetHeader, SetText or SetFont call changed. Reviewed #1261: the unavailable-tracker message uses the client's on-screen notice area. It never writes to a tracker widget. Reviewed #1263: RefreshTracker appends the active walk instruction to the current leg text via the same tracker line. Reviewed #1335: ReadableFont moves block headers, lines, dashes (ObjectiveTrackerLineFont, stock Font12) and the section header (ObjectiveTrackerHeaderFont, stock Font14) onto the stock object while a tracker addon holds the shared font under the game's minimum, and back once it stops; no phrase or SetText call changed. Reviewed #1343: the fallback is now the addon's own ShortestPathForeverLineFont and HeaderFont (CreateFont, face from ChatFontNormal) because the stock fonts can be shrunk too; RefreshBlockText re-checks sizes; dock rows key by destination (#1310); no phrase or SetText call changed. Reviewed #1357: the fallback fonts get the tracker's (1, -1) black shadow; face, size and phrases are unchanged. Reviewed #1394: the leg menu gains Skip this stop on a farming tour, opened by left or right click; it is a ForeverCore.ContextMenu, so no producer text, SetHeader, SetText or SetFont call changed.

producers.review: Reviewed the avoided transport failure row from AvoidTransport.Row, which JourneyInfo returns as its first row. UI/Tracker.lua passes the row text to AddObjective using ShortestPathForeverTrackerLineTemplate, which inherits ObjectiveTrackerLineFont. Pin consumers use template-owned tooltip fonts. Rechecked tracker rendering after the search retry change. JourneyInfo selects the existing error text for a thrown search. The avoid row uses the same font and phrase when the planner finds no route after filtering.

producers.review: Read Tracker.xml and its Tracker.lua LINE_TEMPLATE, LayoutContents and RefreshBlockText callers. ShortestPathForeverTrackerLineTemplate inherits ObjectiveTrackerLineTemplate without a font override; pinned Blizzard_ObjectiveTrackerShared.xml gives both Text and Dash ObjectiveTrackerLineFont. TrackerSection.Create passes this line template to the module; TrackerLine.SetInteractive changes mouse scripts only. XML declares no locale phrase or addon runtime text, so bindings live with the phrases in Tracker.lua. Dynamic row text and client QUEST_DASH are excluded.

Read Page, Checkbox, Scale, Dropdown and Saving and their registration calls. Settings rows, index buttons and option labels delegate to Blizzard secure initializers; this file creates no FontString and establishes no explicit FontObject. Minimap button text, tooltip text, chat output and helper arguments are excluded rather than assigned an assumed settings font. Reviewed #1094: the Tracker heading's Attach to quest tracker row is ForeverCore.SettingsSections.RegisterTrackerAttach, a core-owned initializer, registered only when the running core has it (an older adopted standalone does not); excluded with the other settings fonts. Reviewed #1142: the journeyHint row is one more Checkbox helper call, a Blizzard secure initializer with no FontString or FontObject of its own. Reviewed #1033: the Off-path tolerance row and Arrival distance share a DistanceSlider helper that registers a Blizzard secure slider initializer, with no FontString or FontObject of its own. Reviewed #1005: the Avoided transport row is one more native button initializer with plain string text and tooltip; the client owns its fonts. Reviewed #1241: the new "Show the journey key hint on the minimap" row is one more Checkbox helper call, like journeyHint in #1142, so it adds a Blizzard secure initializer's row and no FontString or FontObject of its own; the digest moved for the row and its shortened journeyHint description, not for a font producer. Reviewed the RestedXP tooltip updates. Blizzard settings initializers own their fonts. Reviewed #1261: the update notice description still goes through the Blizzard Checkbox initializer, which owns its font. The RestedXP arrow dropdown uses the existing Blizzard initializer and its fonts. The Questie journey hint is tooltip text passed to the existing Blizzard dropdown initializer. Reviewed #1350: Use TomTom's arrow is one more Checkbox helper call delegating to the Blizzard secure checkbox initializer, adding no FontString or FontObject. Reviewed #1391: Route to your map pin is one more Checkbox helper call to the Blizzard secure checkbox initializer, adding no FontString or FontObject.

Read Register and every rows builder call. All phrases are helper arguments to Settings.lua builders and Blizzard settings initializers, with no explicit FontObject in this producer. Tooltip descriptions and dynamic choice labels have no coverage claim. The minimap walking route size uses the existing Scale builder, whose Blizzard slider initializer owns its fonts. The minimap trail label uses the existing Checkbox builder and its Blizzard initializer. Reviewed #1342: Show the Nearby services map button uses the same Checkbox builder and Blizzard initializer; tooltip phrasing updated to opens without changing any font or widget. Reviewed #1367: the Line style row uses the existing Dropdown builder and its Blizzard initializer, with no explicit FontObject.

Read dock, service and portal pin creation and tooltip callbacks. Map.xml defines textures without label FontStrings; localized destination, landing and direction phrases flow into tooltips or helper results, as does the journey click hint (ns.AddJourneyClickHint). Tooltip fonts belong to their templates, menu fonts are not established here, and dynamic location names are excluded. Reviewed the new map filter label and visibility callback. The menu owns its fonts. Reviewed the combat freeze: it sets no text.

Read Number creation and SetStop/tooltip paths. Number explicitly uses GameFontNormal but displays a dynamic stop number, not a locale phrase. The time-distance phrase, stop descriptions and clear hints are tooltip text owned by the tooltip template; none is bound to Number.

Read Create, ArrowLabel, distance updates, arrival labels, progress and cast prompt. MoverHint uses GameFontHighlightSmall and Distance uses GameFontNormal, including the formatted time-distance phrase. No later font override occurs. Dynamic objective lines, arrival titles, route titles and actions from helpers are excluded; this review does not claim coverage for their inserted text. Reviewed #1161: NativeMarkerAt and the shared-marker stand-down read C_Navigation and C_Map only; no FontString, FontObject or text change. Reviewed #1035: the cast prompt's secure button moved to UI/CastButton.lua and writes only GameTooltip text; no FontString, FontObject or text change here. Reviewed RestedXP arrow ownership: direction visibility changes without changing text, font objects or bindings. Reviewed #1251: the corpse-run exception in DirectionsShown is removed; visibility only, no FontString, FontObject or text change. Reviewed #1254: ArrowShown is split out of DirectionsShown, and the hidden-for-RestedXP path now places the native marker without drawing the frame; visibility and marker placement only, no FontString, FontObject or text change. The RestedXP arrow mode controls visibility and leaves the existing font bindings in place. Reviewed #1263: GuideInstruction is displayed by RefreshTravelLines on frame.Lines using GameFontHighlightSmall. The travel widget adds a fourth line only while the cave instruction is visible. The font and text binding stay the same. Reviewed #1350: ArrowShown and ArrowLeads gate visibility and lead on ns.TomTomArrowActive, PointGuideArrow syncs TomTom ownership before ArrowShown, and ArrowBearingChanged lazily creates the frame on fallback; no FontString, FontObject or text change. Reviewed #1349: Update shows the frame and notifies ArrowLeadChanged when DirectionsShown transitions and PointArrivalPin preserves held-stop arrival state while hidden; visibility and lead state only, no FontString, FontObject or text change. Reviewed #1308: SetArrowShown lets another addon's arrow stand in for ours, and ArrowBearingChanged creates the frame while that arrow keeps it hidden; visibility and lead state only, no FontString, FontObject or text change. Reviewed #1404: RefreshArrowLines wakes the update loop only while the frame is shown and RedrawGuideMarker clears the rendered point so the next tick places the native marker again; no FontString, FontObject or text change.
